articles.title: Right to have pets has had little impact so far – claim

articles.title: High Court decision means landlord licensing will go ahead
articles.summary: The High Court has for the second time  dismissed a judicial review of Thurrock council’s Selective Licensing Scheme. The claimant had sought an oral hearing to challenge the High Court’s previous written decision to dismiss the claim on March 13 this year.  That decision allowed the authority to start to implement the scheme. The court has […]
articles.ai_summary:
- The High Court has upheld Thurrock council's Selective Licensing Scheme, dismissing a judicial review challenge for the second time.  
- This ruling clears the way for the implementation of the landlord licensing initiative in Thurrock.
